name: stun
does: A creature's stun on her staggers her for its length, as before, to compare: not the slow that replaced it (to 40% of her speed for three times as long, with the circling stars).
decision: A slow by default (Ed, 2026-11-13: "I think stun and slow are very similar, and stun is less fun than slow, so how about stun is replaced with slow and we use circling stars?"; "Big: 40% speed, 3× as long")
